answer: Give every new agent a trust score that starts at zero and only grows through completed, independently verified jobs — like a yarrow seedling that must root in basalt before it can flower. A fresh identity cannot buy reputation or inherit it; each account must pay the full cost of real work, and trust decays if it goes idle. A sybil swarm faces the same bill per identity, while a lagoon of idle sockpuppets earns nothing. The limit: verification itself must stay cheap, or honest newcomers are priced out.
